/* ------------------------------------------------------- the DRUM grid --- */
/* SEQ > NOTES on a DRUM track is the grid: 8 lanes x the 16 steps of a page. The white keys are the
 * steps of the page shown (a tap toggles the selected lane there), black keys 1..8 select the lane (and play
 * it), black key 9 held is ACC (white keys toggle accents, their LEDs show them), black keys 10 / 11 the page
 * down / up. KNOB 1 LANE, 2 HIT, 3 ACC, 4 VELOCITY edit the selected steps ((2.0) PRESETS the cursor). A sound load
 * never converts the steps: the grid shows a step's notes on their lanes (eng_drum.c step_lanes) and an edit makes
 * the lane its own (grid_own). Live recording on a DRUM track writes hits (seq.c rec_note) */
static int grid_on(void) { return !ui.home && !ui.menu && !ui.confirm && step_page(cur_page()->graph) && drum_track(TSEL); }   /* (NOTES only: FEEL is SC_STEP too) */
static void ota_show(uint32_t step, int32_t code) { if (step == 9) last_code = code; }

#define OCT_BREATH_DN 8u                                /* OCT- breathing (the menu: the previous value) */
/* (Skiff 1.3, from Felucca 1.2, Discussions #72 / #73) MOMENTARY: LFO held, the knobs' changes are temporary. KNOB
 * 1..4 on HOME and on the sound and FX pages (a value of the selected track or a global sound / FX one, as edit_param
 * sets it; MIXER's LEVEL PAN REVERB MUTE too; not on the action pages, the lists, the steps, AUTOMATION, SONG or a
 * sheet, where the knobs pick) change their value as ever, and each value turned is put back as it was when LFO is
 * let go: hold LFO, sweep the filter, let go, it snaps back ((2.0, D 2A) comes back over MENU > CONTROL > RETURN, a bar
 * by default, as FX's macros and PERFORM's throws do: ui.c mom_poll; the footer says it). OCT+ while LFO is still held
 * KEEPS them (OCT+ breathes while something would go back). LFO's tap (its page) is dropped once any knob turned with
 * it; LFO alone still opens LFO. Temporary turns are not recorded as automation and take no undo; a sound or project
 * load meanwhile puts that track's values (and the global ones) back first (ui.c mom_back). The menu, a dialog, NAME
 * or a layer let them go too. Up to MOM_LFO values at a time ("MOMENTARY FULL" past them: the turn does nothing) */
static int mom_down(void)                              /* LFO held where its turns are momentary */
{
    return ((fm1_in.buttons >> panel.btn[B_LFO]) & 1u) && !ui.menu && !ui.confirm && !name_on() && !ui.layer && !ui.uboot;
}

static uint32_t lock_id(uint32_t k)
{
    uint32_t id = !ui.plk_src || !lock_page_ok(ui.plk_src - 1u) ? ENGINES[TSEL->eng_req % NENGINES]->knob[k & 3u] :
                  PAGES[ui.plk_src - 1u].graph == GR_LANES ? ((k & 3u) == 1u ? P_LN0 + page_lane() :
                                                              (k & 3u) == 2u ? P_LTUNE0 + page_lane() :
                                                              (k & 3u) == 3u ? P_LDECAY0 + page_lane() : 0xFFu) :
                  PAGES[ui.plk_src - 1u].graph == GR_LMIX ? ((k & 3u) == 1u ? P_LN0 + page_lane() :
                                                             (k & 3u) == 2u ? P_LPAN0 + page_lane() : 0xFFu) :
                  PAGES[ui.plk_src - 1u].graph == GR_MOD ? ((k & 3u) == 3u && mod_ui_route < MOD_SLOT0 ?
                                                            MOD_FIXED[mod_ui_route] : 0xFFu) :   /* (a slot's: none,
                                                                                                  * as before) */
                  PAGES[ui.plk_src - 1u].id[k & 3u];
    return id < P_COUNT && motion_param(id) ? id : 0xFFu;
}
